svg.title: Chunk meshing
svg.desc: buildChunkMesh() runs on worker threads: visible faces only, baked AO, a compact vertex and three index ranges (opaque, cutout, water).
svg.text: buildChunkMesh() runs on worker threads: visible faces only, baked AO, a compact vertex and three index ranges (opaque, cutout, water).
Hidden only behind an opaque cube. Water skips water; leaves keep their inner faces.
one real chunk: 10 420 vertices · 3 222 opaque + 12 408 cutout indices
Two sides and the diagonal give a level 0–3; the quad diagonal is flipped to stay isotropic.

g.text: ao = side1 && side2 ? 3 : side1 + side2 + corner
ambient *= (1 − 0.2·ao)² · flip if ao₀ + ao₂ > ao₁ + ao₃

svg.text: Position inside the chunk, one packed word and a biome tint (RGBA8 on [0, 2], 0x80 = 1.0).
blend + count: neighbouring surface (grass, sand, snow) and how many blocks around the corner use it — the shader turns them into pixel-art transitions.
